title: Maryland crab soup
lead:
'''Maryland crab soup''' is made with lump [[Maryland crab]] meat, tomatoes, corn, potato, cellery or celery leaves, peas, onion, and [[Old Bay Seasoning|Old Bay]]. The main liquid of the soup can be water, shellfish [[Stock (food)|stock]], or fish stock. Other seasoning options used include red pepper, [[bay leaf]], [[thyme]], garlic, dry mustard,  and/or salt.  Different variations may include other additional vegetables such as carrots, green beans, lima beans, jalapeños, or chili peppers. Lemon juice and [[worcestershire sauce]] may be added as well.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-07-30 |title=How to make Wit & Wisdom’s Maryland crab soup |url=https://www.baltimoresun.com/2015/07/30/how-to-make-wit-wisdoms-maryland-crab-soup/ |access-date=2026-01-26 |website=Baltimore Sun |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Maryland Crab Soup Recipe |url=https://www.visitmaryland.org/article/maryland-crab-soup-recipe |access-date=2026-01-26 |website=Maryland Office of Tourism |language=en}}</ref>
